question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"****Curiocity"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Curiosity** is the enthusiastic desire to learn about something.

 
 
• ***Example:** Lisa's **curiosity** led her to ask more questions.*
 
 
 
• There is no word **Curiocity** in English.
 
• **Curiocity** is spelt incorrectly among the given options.
